convert_buffers(buffer_format: BufferFormat, overwrite: bool = False)
convert_images(image_format, destination_dir=None, overwrite=False)

Convert images to an image format

GLTF files can store the image data in three different formats: In the buffers, as a data uri string and as external images files. This converts the images between the formats.

Parameters:

  • image_format (ImageFormat) – Destination Image format.

  • destination_dir (str) – Destination path, optional. Must be a directory. If None, will use load directory.

  • overwrite (bool) – Default = False. Set to True to overwrite a file if it exists.

export_image(image_index: int, destination: str = '', overwrite: bool = False)

Export an image to a file

Parameters:

  • image_index (int) – Image index

  • destination (str) – Destination path. Can be a directory or a file.

  • overwrite (bool) – Default = False. Set to True to overwrite a file if it exists.
